title: Facial Expressions & Emotion Learning
core_message: Expressions can give us clues, but asking kindly is the best way to understand how someone feels.

items.clues: Smiling mouth, lifted cheeks, warm sparkling eyes.
items.example: When you finish a fun puzzle or share a snack with a friend.
items.kind_response: Smile back or say: I am glad you are happy!

items.clues: Downturned lips, looking down, gentle tears.
items.example: When a favorite toy gets misplaced or a friend moves away.
items.kind_response: Offer a gentle word: Would you like a hug or a quiet moment?

items.clues: Tight eyebrows pulled down, clenched jaw, firm lips.
items.example: When something feels unfair or someone interrupts unexpectedly.
items.kind_response: Give calm space: Take deep slow breaths together.

items.clues: Wide open eyes, raised eyebrows, open mouth.
items.example: When sudden loud thunder booms outside or in the dark.
items.kind_response: Reassure them: You are safe here with me.

items.clues: Round eyes, arched high eyebrows, round open mouth.
items.example: When you receive an unexpected birthday gift or see a colorful rainbow.
items.kind_response: Share the wonder: Wow, that was unexpected!

items.clues: Tilted head, one raised eyebrow, slight squint.
items.example: When instructions are new or a puzzle seems tricky.
items.kind_response: Encourage gently: Let us look at this step together.

items.clues: Wide open smile, shining eyes, enthusiastic posture.
items.example: When getting ready to visit the science park or play a favorite game.
items.kind_response: Celebrate together: That is so exciting!

items.clues: Calm focused gaze, hand gently near chin, resting expression.
items.example: When planning a chess move or deciding which book to read.
items.kind_response: Wait patiently: Take all the time you need to think.

items.clues: Looking away softly, gentle small smile, tucked shoulders.
items.example: When meeting a new classmate for the very first time.
items.kind_response: Greet warmly: Hello! It is very nice to meet you.

items.clues: Winking eye, cheerful grin, energetic tilt.
items.example: When playing tag or telling a silly riddle.
items.kind_response: Laugh and enjoy: You are funny!

items.clues: Wrinkled nose, curled upper lip, turning away.
items.example: When smelling spoiled food or touching sticky mud.
items.kind_response: Wash hands and find clean fresh air.
